recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body studio portrait of a woman in black attire posed dynamically on a chair against a vibrant, solid pink background, featuring a diagonal script signature in the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between the black silhouette of the subject and the saturated pink backdrop
Diagonal alignment between the subject's extended leg and the angled script text
Central vertical axis anchored by the chair back, with limbs creating asymmetrical balance
Soft studio lighting on the face and hair contrasting with the flat graphic quality of the clothing
coreInvariants: Subject wearing all-black clothing (tights, heels, top)
A wooden chair used as a structural prop for the pose
Single-word script text placed at a roughly 30-degree upward angle

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame with an extended leg reaching toward the bottom right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, vertical silhouette of the chair back provides a stable central anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the subject's face, follows the curve of the arms to the chair, moves down the extended leg, and is pulled back up by the diagonal text in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open pink space in the upper left and upper right corners to allow the subject and text to breathe.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm Skin Tones and Blonde Hair (Subject's face)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with low value, high contrast foreground elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with a slight upward slant
letterConstructionRules: Large, expressive capital initial with a long descender/flourish
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial capital letter features a wide, sweeping crossbar or loop
Terminal letters end in a soft, natural taper
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Standalone script against a photographic background.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the personal, informal feel of the original lettering.
Maintains the consistent stroke width seen in the reference.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio photograph of a woman with blonde hair in a 1980s style, wearing a black turtleneck and black tights, sitting backwards on a black wooden chair. One leg is extended to the side. The background is a solid, vibrant magenta-pink. Soft lighting on the face.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single word in the upper right corner using a black, monolinear cursive script. The text should be tilted upwards at a 30-degree angle.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, saturated pink?
Is the subject's clothing entirely black?
Is the text angled upwards in the top right?
Is the lighting soft on the subject's face?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for high contrast between black clothing and pink background.
Ensure the script text is monolinear and slanted.
Verify the composition leaves enough negative space in the upper corners.
Confirm the chair is a simple, dark structural element.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Solid Saturated Backdrop + High Contrast Silhouette + Angled Monoline Script Overlay
